string.text: I managed to find Gunslinger's stash, but it seems there's nothing of interest here - aside from a book with an inscription on the endpaper stating that a PDA containing valuable data has been re-hidden in the basement levels behind the southern complex at the Agroprom Research Institute. I need to try to get inside and track it down...

Yeah, I heard that Rat gave you the keys to the old place. You're telling me to put another safe in there? Well, you can, of course. Only, I think you should understand some of the details. First of all, the safe itself - I remember there was one in some hut here near the Bar... let's say I put it together. The safe must have a lock that's in good working order, so that no one will steal anything, because here - people are clever and will do anything to get what they need or to get some quick cash. And most importantly, so that no one steals the safe, it should be magnetized to something so that it doesn't go anywhere. Magnetizing it against wall of the house would work, I'll tell you how. You know about the Magnet artifact, right? Only a few people know this: it has a specific property - if you stick it to something, it'll magnetize it, regardless of what it's made out of. Anyway, I'll help you, but I'll need 5,000 roubles for the job upfront. And I'll need four Magnet artifacts. Do you agree?

Wow! A local legend, here in my workshop! Oh, well. I'm Amethyst. I repair weapons and equipment. You know it's kind of hard to do that around here, so I got into the Ecologist business. Never enjoyed scrouging through truck cemetaries and waste landfills anyhow. So, do you need anything fixed?
A bunch of regular of 5x25mm bolts. These are normally bought fromm hardware stores and used for various DIY repair projects, but in the Zone - these are used by the Gravity Shotgun as ammo.

We are scientists, we are interested in everything that happens here.. So, as I already said, the mutant we're looking for is quite rare in these parts, but recently a group of Freedom members located in the dead city of Bright Beam noticed the mutant we're looking for wandering in the general vicinity of the ruined high-rise buildings. This specific mutant is of particular interest to us. The Freedomers have may have noticed the mutant however, and we need the mutant to be safe - they might injure it, so please make sure it's alive and unharmed. You see, our group is small, and we need to collect material, so you must catch this mutant for us. We need living tissue samples, so we can't kill the monster. Try to lock him up somewhere in one of the city's apartments, or in any other suitable place. That's it - please don't botch this job if you take it.
Stalker! Phew... Thought I was done for...

Well, I guess the truth is out there. Now I can power down the mythical Black Monolith. I need to go down to the lower levels of the lab under Radar, and get to the control room of the installation. The lower door access code is 5489.

Snitch sent me a message with a request. He wants me to find some kind of gravity-based device, supposedly made by some Burers, that's located somewhere within the basements of the Agroprom Research Institute and bring it to him.

Professor gave me an assignment to catch a live Flesh specimen. How on earth am I going to do this? The hell he knows. It's probably gonna take a lot of running, Fleshes are fickle and cowardly creatures. According to these coordinates, there's a Flesh at one of the houses at Bright Beam.

I need to provide covering fire for the Yantar scientists that are leaving via helicopter. Professor gave some kind of rifle that must be returned after the mission is finished. Also, I can't go to the nearby village and attract attention to myself by shooting everything that moves - I'll have to do this quietly.

This is an experimental artifact crossbreeding device. Developer by scientists at the Lake Yantar laboratory, this device allows the creation of various artifacts - provided that you have the needed recipe for the artifact that you want to create.

Next assignment from Toad: you need to find some kind of artifact on the tower that is at the railroad bridge and bring it to him. I need to remember to use the detector... damn, the battery in it is almost drained.
Refuel the generator (a can of gasoline is required)
What are you, drunk? Get down from there!
Who the hell is out there?

The Middleman was generally unsociable, so I don't know about his affairs. He rarely came here, and if he did, he wasn't here for long. He was often seen at Yantar because he was testing something for the scientists there before. He came to the bar today, about an hour before his body was found. Before he died, he asked about all sorts of things - including questions about you.

The last person who talked to him was Sanya Hog. Things weren't the warmest between them, you know. I once heard that Middleman ditched Sanya for some loot when they went to the Garbage. They just had another scandal today, and I had to kick them out. So far, all suspicions fall on Sanya, especially since he wanted to get away when he was found at the murder scene.

Maybe someone's trying to cover their tracks by using your name. I think Mope was hanging around the table where Sanya was standing. Where he is now, I don't know. He left when the trouble started, which makes him suspicious. I should talk to the Snitch about this. Hubby was just talking to him.

I've been there, up north. I went through the Incinerator. I spent three days hiding from Monolith soldiers, in basements. Then back I went and got caught in a blowout. I've been hit by blowouts twice already, I'm all messed up. I've been told there's a clinic in the 'Big Land', where they treat this kind of thing, fixing your brain. Yet, here I am, I'm still alive.
Hello stalker, what do you need?
I'd rather keep things quiet for now. Come back in the morning.

I caught rabies from a dog bite. I was lucky that I had the opportunity to recover. From now on I'll need to be more careful with dogs; it turns out that these creatures are not as harmless as you might think at first glance. I bet that most of them are infected with rabies - and it's insidious. Symptoms appear spontaneously and not immediately.

Professor said that a car with a load from the Big Land was driving to the mobile base. His radio communication with it was cut right at the entrance to the Exclusion Zone at the Cordon. I need to find the scientist and deliver the cargo to Professor. He didn't say anything about the cargo itself, but since his colleague was traveling by car, delivering the cargo on foot could be problematic.

The Journalist followed me north... and disappeared. The Doctor told me to start by checking an apartment in Bright Beam - apparently the Journalist had been using it as a waypoint. \n \nMaybe I'll find something.

I can't believe you've made it to nuclear power plant at Chernobyl. If you do decide to sneak inside in order to get to the Monolith, listen... The entrance to the reactor is behind the plant, on the north side. There's a pair of double gates. I hope you know what you're doing.
You can't sleep when enemies are nearby
You're too heavily loaded to walk.
Starting/turning off the engine - $$ACTION_turn_engine$$. Controls: $$ACTION_forward$$$$ACTION_lstrafe$$$$ACTION_back$$$$ACTION_rstrafe$$. Shifting gears - $$ACTION_crouch$$, $$ACTION_accel$$.
You need some gasoline and an battery.

Stalker, it's Toad. I can't believe you've made it to nuclear power plant at Chernobyl. If you do decide to sneak inside in order to get to the Monolith, listen... The entrance to the reactor is behind the plant, on the north side. There's a pair of double gates. I hope you know what you're doing!

Yeah, one more thing - there's a job. In that place, in the hangars, there's a passageway. There, deep underground, on the lower level of the tunnels, the stalkers discovered a large metal gate. Scans have confirmed that there are large rooms behind the gates. Come on, go downstairs and see what's going on. Report back to me later. I'm uploading any information about the entry point to those rooms into your PDA.
I remembered a code. It's 3781, and it seems to be for some door that's located underground. I think it might be in the tunnels under.. Rostok?
This device is a prototype, and its intended function seems to be for emitting psionic radiation. Since this device is a unrefined prototype, it has a good chance of malfunctioning.

Listen, we got a case for you. Have you heard of the Monolithians? They're local fanatics. They believe a crystal or monolithic block from space fell on the roof of the power plant. Guys say that no one can come closer than 30 meters to them, or they immediately start shooting.

Anyways, our snipers started spotting them on the road to the Swamps. This is no good, I can feel it. I suspect they've got a staging area somewhere up there by the road to the Swamps. You should go see what's out there.. but, you know, we're not really in conflict, we don't touch each other, but they're still fucking unpredictable. There's no guarantee they won't attack us tomorrow. See if you can find where they've settled. The snipers that are observing them told me that they're mostly active at night, so I think after midnight you'll have a chance of catching up with them.

A INDY-series artifact detector. This device was the first artifact detector developed by scientists in the Zone. Its ineffective and outdated if compared to newer detectors because of its short detection radius, which is only 40 meters, and the fact that it only indicates the presence of artifacts with only an audiable beep that increases in intensity when its user gets closer to artifact it has detected. Despite this, this device was revolutionary when it was first introduced years ago, making artifact hunting much easier for stalkers.

A PRO-series artifact detector. This detector is an improved version of the INDY-series artifact detector, developed by scientists working in the Zone looking to improve on the artifact detection device they've developed. This arifact detector works by displaying a satellite map of the local area its user is in and tagging any detected artifacts with markers on the map, giving a precise estimation of their location. Additionally, the PRO-series artifact detector has had its scanning radius increased to 70 meters. Due to its reasonable price and improved performance, this detector is one of the most popular among stalkers in the Zone.

A SUPER-series artifact detector. This detector is the one of the latest detectors developed by scientists working in the Zone. Thanks to advancements in nanotechnology, this device's scanning radius has been increased to 1.5 kilometers. This devices designates artifacts when they're detected by giving them markers and putting them on a relevant satellite map so that the user can figure their specific location. This detector also recognizes artifact types, using an artifact encyclopedia stored in the device's memory storage as a reference to check against, making this device the best artifact detector you can get.

Don't worry, and don't you dare threaten me here. The Dutyers have an interest in my work, and I'm not afraid of anything. They'll protect me if they have to. Anyway, you said you came by to say hello? Hmm. You're a stalker, huh? I can see from your face that you're clearly an experienced man, you must have seen a lot. When you're out in the Zone, bring me one of these if you get a chance. This is, so to speak - my main object of study here in general. I've sent a information of what I'm looking for to your PDA. I'll pay you well for your trouble, don't worry. This thing is rare, it doesn't come along very often, and I need it. Take care.

Would you believe me if I told you what organization I'm from? Ha, I'm not sure you would. The fact that you got the artifact really speaks volumes about you - at least for me. I think you and I have a business relationship to continue. Here, here's 500 roubles. Anyway, you want to know more about that artifact you got for me? It's not easy to study it. Although it does appear in the Zone, its true properties I do not yet know. All I know is that it's not a simple little trinket. There's something hidden in it, something beyond our understanding. Yeah, something like certainly sounds commonplace here in the Zone, but this artifact is a truly unique specimen in terms of its potential... Tell you what, come see me in a day. I will do some experiments with this sample. Afterwards, if you come back, I'll pay you twice as much for your next assignment.

And the fact that even with partial activation, it was possible to do.. something with this artifact. That's what you're going to find out - you need to do a practical experiment. Here, take a sample. You need to do a full activation of this artifact. How do you do that? It's very simple. It needs to be exposed to ultra-high temperatures. I don't know the neighborhood much, so I have no idea where to get a heat source higher than a hundred or two degrees around here. You've seen a lot of things, haven't you? In general, throw the sample in some place with elevated ambient temperature and see what happens. Then report back to me what you see. As promised, I'll pay twice as much as last time. Alright, go, I'll wait for the results.

I decided to raid the Agroprom Research Institute with our local attraction from the death truck... and why not? He even got me a gravity gun to go with it. It's good stuff. I don't forget where I left my backup science outfit from the last raid. I hid it in the cab of the locomotive, I think I'll remember it when I see it. The main thing is that nobody steals it by the time I get there.

Looks like another errand. On the roof of the factory, the Flesh that we've slaughtered has made a lair there. Toad says there are documents located there. We should find them and bring them to him. If I don't get the documents, he won't talk to me.

A Duty stalker in the bar offers to exchange ammunition, and other things, such as gasoline for vodka. At night he can be found at their base, or in its general vicinity - if he's there, he'll agree to barter. However, it is not clear how it may end up.
What are you doing out there?
Spread out! It's about to start! According to the intel, the Blind Dogs' lair was supposed to be in that hollow over there- Stalker! Get over here, we need your help!
Stalker, you're in Duty territory. Don't you dare shoot or cause trouble here.
Stalker, this is Duty outpost! If you're going to go to the Bar, you can come through.

We got a tip from Lone Wolf. He made it clear that they wouldn't just let me into the bar. We need to get some documents from the Dark Valley. This will be my fee for passing into the circle of experienced stalkers. There's some crazy psionic energy at the Dark Valley, we need protection. Lone Wolf told me about a special helmet you can get from the military, near the creek in the Garbage.
The door! Close the door, this isn't a passageway.

You've been to the factory, haven't you? They say it's notorious among stalkers and that anyone who goes into the attic will have bad luck. There's a guy at the Garbage with a bandaged eye who said a legendary stalker once died of treachery in that place.

Yeah, well.. yeah. In the grand scheme of things, it's up to you, but I need a simple anomaly detector. I heard there's one hidden in the attic of the factory.. unless, of course, it's already been stolen. If you get it, I'll give you a new 9x18 pistol. It's up to you, kid, if you want to do this or not.

A EX-04 NBC (nuclear, biological, chemical) suit that was designed from the ground up to give protection against the Zone's many hazards. These suits are normally used by expeditions of scientists and stalker-ecologists collaborating with them. Built-in air filtration and air conditioning system.
An empty jar that's made out of special, highly resistant and durable glass. You can store the substance the Studen anomaly is made out of in it.

A medium-sized scientific container, designed for carrying highly dangerous artifacts. Despite its small size, it provides adequate protection against the intense anomalous energy or radiation that the most dangerous artifacts emit. It's made of special heavy-duty plastic, and its outermost layer is coated with a special metal alloy developed at the mobile lab at Lake Yantar that has the same positive properties of lead - but better. These artifact containers are highly sought after by professional artifact hunters.

A medium-sized scientific container, designed for carrying more common and less dangerous artifacts. Despite its small size, it provides adequate protection against the radiation that most artifacts emit - but since this container is a more budget-orientated one, it provides zero protection against the anomalous effects more dangerous artifacts have. It's made of special heavy-duty plastic, and its outermost layer is coated with a special metal alloy developed at the mobile lab at Lake Yantar that has the same positive properties of lead - but better. These artifact containers are highly sought after by professional artifact hunters.

A medium-sized scientific container, designed for carrying moderately dangerous artifacts. Despite its small size, it provides adequate protection from the anomalous energy and radiation that most artifacts have in the Zone. It's made of special heavy-duty plastic, and its outermost layer is coated with a special metal alloy developed at the mobile lab at Lake Yantar that has the same positive properties of lead - but better. These artifact containers are highly sought after by professional artifact hunters.
A special scientific container for artifacts. This container contains one artifact.
A special scientific container for artifacts.
A special scientific container for artifacts.
A special scientific container for artifacts.
A special scientific container for artifacts.
A special scientific container for artifacts.
A special scientific container for artifacts. This container contains two artifacts.
A special scientific container for artifacts. This container contains three artifacts.
A special scientific container for artifacts. This container contains four artifacts.
A special scientific container for artifacts. This container contains five artifacts.
A special scientific container for artifacts. This container contains six artifacts.
A special scientific container for artifacts. This container contains seven artifacts.
A special scientific container for artifacts. This container contains eight artifacts.
A special scientific container for artifacts.
The battery is required to start a vehicle's engine, supplying needed electricity to various components.

This device is colloquially known as the 'Disintegrator'. Its intended function is to alter the properties of an artifact by activating certain particles in it. One of the specific things it can do is turn an artifact into jelly.
That's all you remember about Journalist? You don't know anything else?

Oh, what a friendly stalker! You know, Journalist was also kind and helped me. I recall that one time I was at his place.. he told me a story that stuck with me.. oh, I'm getting sidetracked. Anyway, behind the power plant there are various installations that caused that big Emission that hit me years ago. Journalist also mentioned that he's scouring the local neighborhood for important documents that might give hom some clues. He said he wanted to find out what has happened in the Zone.

An experimental sample of an anti-radiation drug that's designed to protect the human body from various types of radioactive contamination. Its effectiveness - and how long it works - usually no more than a few minutes at best, depends on the drug's expiration date.\nServes as a treatment for radiation sickness.
No, that's all I remember about him. Thank you for your help, I think you'll find what you're looking for.
This device is a personal digital assistant - a small, handheld personal computer that has many uses, such as data management and storage.

The HEALTH-13 kit is an advanced universal medical kit that is highly adatpable and has many uses, able to treat numerous ailments such as wounds, burns, poisoning, and so on. It also allows you to diagnose various diseases of the body and treat them. The HEALTH-13 kit requires special capsules filled with various drugs in order for it to work fully.

A device that measures and catalogs anomalous formations, along with documenting their locations accurately on satellite maps. To use this device, you must approach the anomaly, hold the device in your hands, and activate the device.
A device that shows a map of the Cordon with numerous anomalous formations on it.

%c[255,160,181,169]Professor:\n%c[255,245,240,218]The group we were expecting is now in the Cordon, preparing to evacuate the area. Your job is to go there, and lead the group along the road through the highway to the exit of the area. I'm sending their coordinates, you'll get all the instructions when you get there. Hurry up. Over and out.
Cooked meat. This meat is entirely safe to eat.
Personalized access card. Often used by scientists and security personnel to control access to certain areas.

The “UTV-2”, a prototype scanner of the bioelectrical Activity of the brains of psionic mutants.” \nThe scanner is capable of locating psionic mutants based on the unique rhythm of their brain activity. \nWhen connected to a PDA, it displays their location on the map.

This specific backpack - a military surplus one that's rugged and waterproof, normally comes with the most common and popular stalker suit. You can take it off and use it to make a secret stash in a secluded place.
The Zarya-2 is a flashbang grenade, using blinding light and overwhelming noise to disorientate enemies. These are normally used in hostage rescue or crowd control operations.
A regular handheld flashlight. It's highly durable, able to take a good beating. It's also highly energy efficient and does not not require recharging. In a pinch, you can use this as a club.

A strange, heavily contaminated area. Should you wander deeper into it, you will see a shallow lake, crammed shore-to-shore with abandoned equipment and other debris. You can also check out the abandoned Institute and the factory, though the military have been hanging around there quite a lot recently.

The Duty faction have set up camp on the plain's edge and they always welcome stalkers in need of rest. A desert oasis of sorts - a place completely devoid of anomalies and mutants. Be sure to check out the "Stalker" bar that's in the basement of an department store - it's a meeting point for stalkers from all over the Zone. The bar is run by the local trader, so if you're interested in selling or buying wares apart from the local gossip - that's the place to go to. North of the bar is the Rostok plant, with the Garbage to the South.

Always gloomy, always misty and always rainy. Stalkers venturing into the Dark Valley are likely to find valuable artifacts, instant death, or both. A place frequented by some of the most experienced old-timers, though you may also stumble upon some common bandits. There's supposed to be an underground lab around there somewhere, so it might be worth to look for a hidden entrance along the way. No one has returned from there alive though and no one can tell for sure just what nasty surprises await you there.

Think of this place as the Zone's antechamber - it's a good place for rookies to get their head around. You'll find a trader in an basement in the middle of the village, next to the army outpost. Don't miss the chance to talk to him. You'd be advised to steer clear of the outpost itself, however. You don't want the soldiers to catch a sight of you - most of them shoot first and don't bother asking questions later. Yet, as always, there are some who can be bribed as long as the top brass is looking the other way. Attacking the soldiers is not recommended, unless they pose a direct threat.

A vast machinery graveyard. Right after the first accident whole heaps of radioactive waste were dumped there. Mostly ruins of old buildings infested with mutants. Much like the outskirts of the Zone, the place swarms with rookie stalkers, with an occasional bandit loitering around, always on the lookout for freebies. Some artifacts to be found here, but most of them are just not worth the effort. You'll be better off elsewhere. Going East, you will get to the Wild Territory, West lays the entrance to the Dark Valley, along with the road to the Agroprom Research Institute. To the North, you'll find the entrance to the Stalker bar.

A deserted army base next to a dilapidated hamlet and a small marsh. The Sin faction has settled at the army base - religious fanatics who believe in the divine essence of the Zone and humanity's redemption through punishment for their sins. The village is an eerie place literally swarming with mutants - the bloodsuckers alone are legion. Stalkers do their best to keep away from it, even if it means going extra kilometers around it. The road connecting the base to the Zone is guarded by the "Brain Scorcher", which blocks the way to Pripyat and the Chernobyl NPP.

This used to be a town built for engineers working at the Chernobyl NPP. Quite a big place once, it is a ghost town now with mutants and zombies as the only residents - vast amounts of them are born here. Take care when you get here, being careless will result in your death.

A dreadful place. Easy to vanish without a trace there, no matter how lucky you have been in life so far. Whoever gets close to here immediately goes insane, turns into a zombie and starts stalking the Zone restlessly. A human shell is all thatвЂ™s left. No one has ever returned with a sound mind.

The Rostok plant used to be the site of a rather large manufacturing plant, currently in ruins. Many stalkers met their death there: the place is swarming with all sorts of monsters. The beasts are literally streaming over there from the entire Zone. It is said that something of great importance is hidden at this site, so there are always plenty of daredevils willing to try their luck.

The site of the world-famous nuclear power plant. This is the heart of the Zone. If you believe the legends, this is also the site of the "Black Monolith" - a mysterious thing capable of granting any wish.

The legendary lake in the sector of the same name dried up a long ago, leaving a shallow swamp in its place. The place is morbid and sodden with death. Great dangers await any adventurous soul foolish enough to get near it. Anyone who dares to go too far goes insane. Zombie drones are rambling around the whole sector, waiting for new victims. The lake itself is poisonous - touching it without protection will lead to nasty acid burns. If you walk around the lake and past the zombies, youвЂ™ll end up at the scientists' camp, where the eggheads brought there by choppers are doing some research. You can have a chat with them; they buy artifacts and could even send you on a mission. In the center of the lake there are several large islands made of garbage and the skeletons of buildings. Several paths through shallow water lead to them. The largest one has a descent into an unflooded basement.

There are anonymous reports of strange phenomena noticed in the inner ten-kilometer zone.\nA bad reputation is growing around Pripyat - strange animals have appeared on the streets of the forgotten city at night. After a bus with foreign tourists disappeared in Pripyat, the zone was closed to tourists. Several lengthy investigations have yielded no results. There is no doubt - the bus vaporized in the city, but further investigation yields nothing. \n Local residents brought to the checkpoint the dead body of a strange animal covered with red hair. The mutated creature had a humanoid build, small stature and large black eyes. The mutant was taken away. A few days later, the capital's newspapers refuted numerous rumors that the found corpse belonged to an escaped monkey of one of the maintenance chiefs.

The Chernobyl Scientific Research Institute of Parapsychology, or CSRIP was established in the Soviet Union; its central research building is located near Chernobyl, but various its departments are scattered throughout the territory of the former USSR. Where did research materials come from on a regular basis? The main goals of CSRIP was study and development of human paranormal abilities. Its priority is to develop a new concept of relations between man and the state, and creation of a new society based on the common consciousness of the working masses. Collectivism of a new level is a full-fledged collective mind, covering all areas of human activity and including all citizens of the allied countries.

Following in the tracks of those foolhardy loners who call themselves the stalkers, research expeditions are once again embarking on an in-depth study of the Zone. However, the perimeter guarded by the army has other, dangerous inhabitants now - from common poachers to the worst bandit scum. Most of the stalkers roam the Zone in search of anomalies and the so-called artifacts for which they gain quite a profit.

Rumors arose among the local population that the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant was home to secret government-owned laboratories, thus leading to the theory the explosion that occurred on April 26th, 1986 was due to an overload during an experiment.
After the recent emission, another Toad's Eye artifact appeared in the Garbage. I need to find it and bring it to Toad. He gave me the coordinates. I wonder why no one wants to go after it?
I need to pick up Toad's box.

This is my first serious, real outing. I need to be well prepared. It's probably not a good idea to go alone, either. I need to try and find someone at the Cordon who will agree to go to the Research Institute with me. It's worth talking to the locals, see if anyone will agree. Well, if not, I guess I take my own chances.

Toad sent me a message that says a stalker going by the nickname 'Boar' knows something about Gunslinger. He's located at the northern checkpoint at the Garbage - the one manned by Duty. I need to talk to him, and then go back to Toad. Toad also mentioned something about an eye artifact that Boar has, he wants it for whatever reason.

An experimental sample of a military exoskeleton. It was never mass-produced due to its very high cost and design flaws, and it gives practically zero protection against ballistic damage or anomalies. Despite this, it's in demand due to its ability to take on the weight of all carried equipment, and therefore small batches are made in underground facilities outside Ukraine. A special battery is needed for this exoskeleton to work.

What? We don't do that. Where did you get this information? Although, maybe whoever told you that meant the camp on the marshes. There's a helicopter with equipment there quite often. It's not working right now though, because of the high psionic radiation.
Quiet, quiet, it's all over now...

It seems that the last, seventh part of the documents is missing. However, I got a message from Freedom that one of their groups went missing at the Polesie Hotel, and they had a red folder with them - maybe that's what you need. We should try to find them in the vicinity of the power plant.

Everything happened suddenly My partner died right before my eyes in fraction of a second, he literally burned out from the inside... what was that? And this call.. something was calling me.. I'll need to tell Toad about this when I'm at his bunker.
Find the entrance to the laboratory.
The entrance to the main laboratory is located somewhere in the general vicinity of the Generators. You need to find the entrance to it.

Alright, don't ramble on, we'll get to your base, see what you accidentally grabbed. In the meantime, I should get something to eat, because I've forgotten when I've had anything in my mouth other than knocked out teeth. You didn't grab anything but folders in that archive?
This glass eye that belongs to a stalker named Phil has the code 667 engraved on it. You might want to remember this code.
The code on Phil's glass eye.

You're leaving after all, eh? Even though the old man refused to give you his notes on the cyclical nature of the Winds of Madness. No offense to him, but he's been here in the Zone for a hell of a long time. The Zone, she's like a... What can you compare the Zone to without leaving the Zone? Only with the Zone itself.

I don't take offense. I've got some paperwork right here. I picked them up at the Sin's lair. Maybe you could use them for something. Everything I need to know I already know, and what's missing to complete the picture is not in them anyway, Give it to the professor. I need to go.

Hmm. I don't really need any artifacts, but I do need some parts. Tell you what, if you get me a Killer suit, a specialized protective suit meant for scientists, a HK G36, and five bottles of vodka.. then I'll give it to you. I'll hold it for you. If you don't want to get me all of that stuff, I'll give you what you want for ten grand.
Your weapon has jammed. You need to reload.

The Gravity Glove is a new experimental weapon that deals damage using the forces of gravity. It was developed by scientists who wanted to make a device that weaponizes gravity. This device can attract and repel objects, and it can also work through walls. Its distance limit is 30 meters, and the device's effectiveness depends on how close objects are to it.
Usage: 
1.Abruptly pull an object toward you. 
2.Hit and push an object

Gunslinger, he also came from the outside, they say he was an important figure in the outside world, but nobody really knows anything. There were even rumors that fanatics from the Sin Clan believed that something important depended on him. Maybe he was thrice-born, too?

Hoplite knew something about him, we're from the same village. He always wanted to be a writer, he said he loved the fantasy genre. He's told me about heroes that always acted justly, and even if they were lonely, still defeated evil in the end. Hoplite said something about the Journalist, the latter was looking for something, and Hoplite bragged that he had found it - but whether he gave it to the Journalist or not, I don't know.

You mean the scientist from Yantar? Yeah, he lived here. He disappeared under mysterious circumstances recently. Our guys wanted to check out the apartment, but the door is jammed. One of our guys tried to get to the apartment by walking on top of the wires that lead to it a few times, but he kept falling off. He doesn't want to try again anymore... and it looks like the window's boarded up. I think we're going to have to break the door down, or blow things up.
A fireproof briefcase that contains documents.
A polyethylene file that contains numerous documents.

A thick stack of scientific papers that you found at Lab X-18. They all contain words that are hard to parse for the layman, complex formulas and detailed diagrams, so it's difficult to understand any of the material from them.
A flash drive is a convenient way to store and transfer information.
A PDA is an indispensable device in the Zone for any stalker, useful for things such as cataloging data or maintaining a journal.

This device discharges anomalies. When it interacts with an anomaly, it temporarily neutralizes its anomalous activity and radiation within a radius of approximately 10 meters around the device. To use it, you need to activate the device next to the anomaly.

There's a lot of rumors about this thing, about the Monolith. Rumors of all sorts. Some stalker told me that the Monolith is something like-- What did he say? The basis of all human aspirations and desires? Something unique that a person strives for... Quin-tez-sen-tsi-ya, my ass. He said a lot of clever things, I can't remember them all. But I didn't really listen to him. He was a regular motor-mouth - everytime he visited me, I'd wish that he would shut the fuck up and get out of my basement. Though, he was right about something. Everyone wants to go to the Monolith. Rumor has it it's something extraterrestrial. I heard it landed next to the Sarcophagus, or it punched through the roof of the Sarcophagus and into the fourth reactor, yeah. That's why a lot of people think it caused the Zone.
Messer, I've relocated to a bunker in the hills. Come visit me if you can.
Messer, what's the status with the Institute lake measurements? I asked you to get a water sample from there.
Find someone else, I'm not interested.
What?! Man, this generation... And after all my generosity, too! Fine, it's your mistake.
Ugh, what a stench... Damn, it's even glowing too! Sh... Alright, where's the container... And done. Here's your payment.
Then get it done! This generation...!

Stalkers returning from the Zone sell the artifacts they find to an old trader who used to be a stalker: Toad. He has many connections to the outside world. The customers of artifacts are diverse - scientists, defense contractors, and representatives of corporations. Customers order Toad to collect certain artifacts, and he in turn gives tasks to stalkers. You can also buy weapons and a variety of equipment from him. He ives in the cellar of an abandoned cabin. He's a bossy fat guy with bulging eyes, and he tends to have a very nasty and mean character. He's also dressed in a tank top and pants, and the stump of his left arm is wrapped in black leather. He has difficulty walking because of his broken legs. There are rumors of rookie stalkers that were killed by him, whom he let go on a deliberately deadly mission. But he's the only merchant in the area, so you have to deal with him. He doesn't trust most stalkers with anything, and is frankly rude to most of them. He keeps a shotgun on him just in case, and his mood is as bad as ever.

Damn, this sucks. Woke up in a strange place. That Toad is a very shady man. He wants me to work off what I owe him, fine. I need to pick up a crate from the bench in the merchant's bunker, and then take it to the roadblock. There's a crate containing something that Toad wants at the roadblock - the decoy crate should fool the grunts at the roadblock.

Messer, here's the thing, Jackal's been in touch. He sent out an SOS signal. The message he sent was garbled in the transmission, he had something about some 'dark ones'. Bullshit .I spotted him underground in the Cordon area, obviously from the underground tunnels. Why don't you go check it out? You'll get to see each other face to face.
Don't shoot. I won't harm you.. unless if you want that, of course.
What the... you're not human. How can you talk?
There was a time when... to say... it's not a problem... stalker, do you happen to have anything to eat?

When I was born, the Zone already existed. It's true, the old people said that there was a time that the town they lived in was outside the Zone, but I don't remember that. There are legends that somewhere there is some 'Big Land' or huge city, that's where the helicopters come from sometimes and the new stalkers come from. But something happened there a few years ago. Maybe the visiting stalkers know something more specific about this 'Big Land'.
There's a job. We need to find -
Yeah, there's something. We need to find -
Did you find it yet? I need to -
Did you get it? This thing right here -

You should know, Gunslinger, how many times I've told you this... I worked in a settlement in the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone before the Second Disaster happened. I worked for a newspaper. I was typing something for someone then, uh.. I can't remember now, what, and to whom exactly - the Zone erased almost all my memories of the Big Land. I remember some yellow press where some of the articles were personally sponsored by the mayor. And then it started, the first warning bells. Something's happened here with the military coming in large numbers. It's just like what's happening right now. I remember four trucks of soldiers were brought into our village. A two-story headquarters was built in two days, can you believe it? And the mayor was pale all day. I went to the checkpoints - there were already barbed wire and mines at the entrances to the city. They refuse to answer any questins, they say they're not supposed to answer. Even to the reporters, they said. And then... From the neighboring village, the children left. All of them. At night, when their parents were asleep. There aren't even any babies left. The next morning, there's an uproar, mothers are throwing themselves at the military checkpoints, demanding to know what happened. They thought they'd taken the kids. The military didn't know what was going on. What I saw left me with many questions, but no answers. So I went to that village, for our newspaper. I talked to the locals and asked around, talked to internal affairs. Neither of them don't remember anyhing. It's like everyone's memory has been erased. Not all of it, selectively. But about the kids, they don't remember anything at all. Some couldn't even remember their names. The cops, of course, they blamed it on the vodka, because the people in that village drank a lot. But I've been talking to some acquaintances from there who are teetotalers... No, there wasn't a mass drinking party. What did I learn from them, you ask? Nothing useful. I had to wait. And I waited. Children are starting to disappear from other townships. Same diagnosis - no one remembers anything and no one saw anything. Some were able to stay in their home village or leave for another city out of fear for their child, and others stayed in their home village, believing that no one could protect their child better. That's what everyone thought before the Second Catastrophe. The buses came, people started evacuating. You can't imagine the panic back then. They thought another reactor had exploded. Some of the old-timers have been around since eighty-six. They're the ones who remembered how the army arrived the day after the accident, and the evacuation was much more announced after a considerable amount of time after accident happened. And in our case, things were even worse: the military took too long and they didn't evacuate people until two months later. My neighbor, when I last saw him.. he was calculating something. I asked people I know how he's been dosed. We didn't know what really went on here in those days. And from my perspective, the thought occurred to me that if the kids went anywhere, it was to the Zone. There's nothing there that doesn't confirm an overlap between the two events. I decided one night, I'd sneak into the Zone. Just for one day, just to check things out. I got there just before the military had their first breakthrough into the Zone. I watched them all die in anomalies from afar. Some of the APCs had been abandoned. The ones on the road to the center are often found there to this day. I went deep into the Zone and that's it. It's like the memories of the Big Land have been cut off by something. Slowly, so that I didn't notice. There's still something left to remember. Most important: my name, nickname, how to eat, drink, and how to handle weapons. I can still communicate with people, thankfully. And I can't remember the title of our newspaper I used to work for. I can't remember what's been going on at Kiev. What is it, events in the capital - I can't remember its name... It's possible, that the Zone is taking away our memories? Selectively, I think. Takes away some, and fixes others so you can't get them out of your head. I remember I used to be a journalist. I remember the village, my neighbor, the kids. And the same phrase keeps running through my head: find the children. I can't get any peace. And I'm not gonna rest until I find it. It's the Zone that's holding me back.

There is no Monolith. It doesn't exist and never has existed, Gunslinger. And you're the one who told me that when we were on the outskirts of Radar. Obviously, the Monolith is just another psychotropic facility that was built as a last layer of defense. Defense from who and from what, you ask? From stalkers, of course. But who organized the defense is already a mystery. You knew it, but you didn't have time to tell me. What is true about the rumors of wish fulfillment? It's very hard to say. Someone may have gotten to the Sarcophagus and was able to make a wish at the Monolith. But none of these stalkers are alive. It's also very likely that when a stalker makes a wish, a blowout occurs. I don't know if there's any way to get to the bottom of whoever is behind this. After all, that's what we've been trying to do for a long time. As far as I know, you were trying to get to them during the time you became 'thrice-born'. That's what the stalkers call you, right? I don't know what went wrong then. Maybe the Monolith isn't the last line of defense? Maybe, there's another one and we didn't know about it? I believe there is something else that's protecting whoever is behind this. There's something behind the power plant. But where it is exactly is a mystery. There's also something else alluding us: the location housing the device that can deactivate the installation is unknown. In the meantime, I'm gonna try to get in touch with someone I know. I trust him completely to help me figure this out. You, Gunslinger, can try to get into the center of the Zone again. If I hear anything, I'll contact you.

I know that shortly before the first day, all the children left the settlements near the borders of the current Chernobyl Exclusion Zone. They're probably in the center, on the other side of the Winds of Madness installation. In the South, all the places have been explored by stalkers, but in the north, where there aren't so many people, there may be there. Something happened back there at the center that lured kids to the Zone. Just the kids, not adults. And what metamorphosed them here and turned them into dwarfs is a mystery. I'm sure the center of the Zone also has labs, with evidence explaning what has happened.

It's hard to say. On the one hand, what you're describing are tales that only newbie stalkers that take Toad's bullshit seriously believe. On the other hand, we are in the Zone, where anything is possible. Maybe you really are the Chosen One who can change the world.

I can't go to the Big Land anyway, The Zone is holding me back, it wants me to be here. And I know a lot about the Zone - I know about the labs that helped to create it, and what's going on closer to the center of the Zone. There's no turning back.
On my way out of Bright Beam, I got a message from the Duty faction leader. I need to meet up with him and talk.
Talk to the leader of Duty
A canister filled with gasoline, meant for refueling cars and trucks. It holds a total amount of 15 liters.
Maybe so, but who told you that our cooperation would end there? You're looking for Strelok, aren't you? That is exactly what I can help you with. But only after you take out that scumbag.

Stalker suit from the Killer faction. Its design is based on the suit used by the special forces of Western armies. Due to a special treatment of the fabric, the armor has a strengthened stability during the physical movement of its plates. Its protective properties are slightly better then those of the PSZ-7 military bulletproof suits.

Working for the Killers, that's new. Looks like the clan leader wants to cooperate? Then why are the others hostile? Too many questions. Nevertheless, you need to kill the stalker at the Agroprom Research Institute. He's hiding in the underground. The leader gave me a tip: the basement of the Research Institute can be accessed through the underground of the Garbage so you don't get too irradiated - the direct path to the Agroprom Research Institute's basement has dangerous levels of radiation.

This is serious business - I need need to rescue the commander that was leading a patrol and get him to safety. He's located at the factory where the SOS signal is coming from. I need to check my gear and first aid kits, and a grenade from Toad would be nice.

My brother was forcibly drawn to the killers. He was forced to shoot another stalker, or they would have killed him themselves. There was nothing left for him to do. We need to find him, get him out of the killers' base, then bring him back to our base. Preferably at night, so no one can see you.
Hey, dude! Come over here, we have some business to discuss!
Looks like the plant's human resources department, or some kind of archive.
These medical capsules are meant for the HEALTH-13 universal medical kit.
An empty HEALTH-13 kit that needs to be loaded with medical capsules. Special medical capsules are needed for this kit.
This door is locked, and it looks like its held shut an electronic lock. It'll move a little, but it won't open. It also looks like there were zombies in here.
Stalker, come into the house. I need help.
Hey, stalker, come here! I'm in the house on the hill.

Snitch:\nMesser, one of the stalker squads has decided to move far into the Zone and explore Silent Hills. Among the squad's stalkers, more than half are elite. They were superbly equipped, can you go see what's wrong with them? Anything you find on them is yours. Just tell me what happened to them, alright? There were three stalkers in the group - two in exoskeletons, one was in a black protective suit, unless of course he'd changed costumes. I know for a fact he's a sniper. They went missing at the village. When you find them, contact me. I'll be waiting for the signal.
Hostage scientist: Someone has come! Is it finally over? Hey, stalker! Are you from the Professor?!

Heard a broadcast on an ancient radio. It's most likely from the Big Land that the other stalkers sometimes mention. I don't know if the broadcast was true or false; an old recording or a live broadcast, but I can't believe what I heard. 

...no real cause for serious concern. 

...temporary measures... 

...drastic changes...

 ... 

...decisive steps... 

...radical changes... 

...it's certainly too early to talk about achieving the biological minimum... 

It feels like the Big Land is in the same mess as the Zone, if not worse. You can't help but wonder if Big Land really exists. I've probably been there, in my past. But what if it doesn't? Maybe there is no Big Land. Then where do the stalkers come from, and where does this broadcast come from?

I'm going to tell you a story I tell everyone. It's a legend about the Monolith, quite possibly the cause of the Zone. In 2006, the Zone exploded, measures were taken and the population in the area was evacuated, the Zone was cordoned off by army units. No one knew what was going on, panic all around, the Zone was growing, field labs were powerless. A lot of people died inside. Everyone is afraid of radiation that could cover half of Europe.

A few years went by, the first desperate guys like you showed up. They called themselves stalkers. They penetrated through the army cordons, believing that there was something in the Zone, and that this something could bring them riches, fulfill their desires. Slowly they began to bring back strange things from there, artifacts, for which there was an instant race. Scientists went crazy about these things. They paid a lot of money for one of these specimens, not like now. So, the first stories and legends about what was inside the Zone, near the dilapidated nuclear power plant, appeared. One of the veterans recounted a story heard from one of the local stalker old-timers, a story about the Monolith, supposedly fulfilling wishes. What hysteria began here, stalkers gathered in groups and rushed to the center of the Zone, everyone wanted something from the Monolith. There were grim details about the first stalker to reach the Monolith. Back when the Zone first appeared, many people were trapped by it, cut off from the outside world.

Most of them died, but there were rare lucky ones who not only survived, but tried to do something about it. One of the survivors was near the station, he saw a strange glow inside. He had no choice, the way back was cut off, so he got closer. He saw something that stood out to him - the pierced roof of a sarcophagus, illuminated from within. He climbed the wall and the insides of the Sarcophagus were revealed to him. There, among the piles of metal debris and charred concrete, rested a huge black block. It was the Monolith. Then the stalker snapped out of his trance and realized that he had climbed into the Sarcophagus - the Monolith managed to somehow control him from a mile away. Terror gripped him, and through the fear, the Monolith's call was monotonous. The Monolith was calling him, and the stalker's hair stood on end. Strange, eerie images of the alien exploded in his mind. We don't know what's true or false in this story.

The point is that he made a wish, and it came true, and the Zone sharply increased by five kilometers. It seems that for every wish granted, the Zone eats our Earth. But that doesn't stop the stalkers. They continue to rush inside, carrying to the Monolith their innermost desires....

This is the Professor from Lake Yantar speaking. In case you haven't heard, there are intense concentrations of psionic radiation at the edge of the swamp. Our workers were doing tests there they just.. disappeared - I don't know what happened to them. The door of the house where the switch is located is coded as we know, and the code is in the possession of another group that was working near the swamp; they left the area due to the Phantasm's strong psionic influence. Maybe they'll come back and one of them will tell you the code.
A scientist at the Bar asked me to find any information about his missing brother, who worked at the Rostok factory. He promised to give me a suit if I find anything about his brother.

Yes. Once, it was a big research camp, volunteers came here, equipment was delivered, but we were forgotten over time. First, the influx of volunteers stopped - something in the outside world began to fail.

What's there to talk about when there's stuff going on here in the Zone? This is where every normal scientist should be. It's certainly a shame that there has been a complete cessation of any supply. Our lab now works under an autonomous system. Young employees gradually began to go to other places, some of them joined some stalker clans, someone disappeared in the depths of the Zone. Some of them have died trying to get artifacts, and some others have become a sort of a legend in the Zone. Like the Mad Doctor, for example. He was one of the employees of one of the labs here in the Zone, but it was as if he had become part of the Zone. He developed characteristics not found in a normal person. No, he's not a mutant in the literal sense of the word, but there's something special about him. They say he can heal stalkers crippled by the Zone - literally, from bits and pieces. Or even one of the remains of several. He's also supposedly able to communicate with zombies and even bring them back to normal. However, it's also said that he does this very rarely, as he believes that zombies do not want to return to normal life at all. We also had a guy named, uh.. Journalist, I think. He was obsessed with some sort of international conspiracy idea. He was babbling about globalists most of the time, stating that they brought kids to the Zone for some reason.

They say there are some, but nobody really knows anything. I think there is such an order - a close-knit group of people trying to maintain the status quo. They are also called Angels of the Zone, or adherents of the Monolith cult. They guard the center from which, according to rumors, the general management of all life in the Zone is carried out.
That's it, and now I need a drink. Come back later.
The PSI installation's power is turned off.
Turn off the power to the PSI installation.
Disconnect the power supplied by the power plant
Open the front door to the complex
The power to the unit is turned off
Emergency containment of the complex has been deactivated
Turn on the first floor lights
Turn on the second floor lights

I can help with that, but the result won't be immediate. You'll have to make inquiries, asking who's been where, when.. and one more thing. There are two options you can choose from.\nSo the first... if you give me two thousand roubles, I'll send you the approximate location of the document you're interested in a little while to your PDA.\nThe second option will cost you more: I'm the one who's pulling my strings and getting you the document you need. All you have to do is come and get it from me. It will cost more ten grand total. So, what do you need to find?
Digital lighting control. Control codes: 1 - on, 2 - off.
This suit is a modified NBC suit, giving excellent protection against high levels of radiation. It'll also filter out any radiation from its user's body if it's kept in good working order.

A regular coat that's made out of of thick cloth that has a hood, a pair of jeans, and a pair of high boots. This set of clothes presumably came from outside the of the border of the Zone. It'll give you some protection against scratches or wounds, but it won't protect you against the Zone's anomalies.
A notebook with personal notes in it
You have to remember to keep your PDA charged, especially during raids.
News and events in the Zone
Great, head to the bunker site.

No, I'm certainly convinced that this is the real artifact... something that doesn't exist. But! In principle, its existence does not contradict my hypothesis about the interaction of complex geofactors, in the sum acquiring completely new properties, which are almost impossible to predict from the properties of the constituent objects of the system...

That depends on how you look at the question, young man. Once upon a time I worked in one of the famous institutes dealing with management problems, we had a modest laboratory there. Actually, what do you know about our perception of information from the outside world?

However, you are quite drowsy, young man. No, by the external world I mean the world outside of a person, as opposed to their internal world. Although in some ways it can be compared to the Zone as well. So, what makes you so sure that everything you see and feel is actually happening, that your perception is in accordance with the surrounding reality and not induced by this very surrounding reality? Take the zombies for example - do you think they see the world the same way you do?

What about happiness? Which one of you is happier? By the way, there's a town not far away, and only zombies live there. What about wish fulfillment? Who's desires and perception of reality are in a more harmonious relationship?

We all, in one form or another, try to forget anything that involves strong negative emotions or stress. Otherwise, a person simply won't survive under our circumstances. If the stress is great, or maybe it's the global influences, or geofactors... or..

Discovered a strange mutant. It looks like a meter maid, only more disfigured. Maybe we can find something interesting to do with this mutant. Something tells me this mutant isn't just a simple mindless goon, there's something else going on.

Everything seems ready for the trek north. The people from Duty should be waiting at Radar by now. My window of opportunity is from 9 PM to 11 PM.I need to break into the lab and shut down the Woodpecker before time runs out. After that, in theory, the road to Pripyat will be open.
Shit. It's clearly not worth sticking around here for long... and where are all these scientists?
It's alright, come on in. We're just waiting for you.

We need to investigate the underground utilities beneath the Cordon. Before me, a group of stalkers had already disappeared there. You need to find some interesting thing for Toad from there and bring it to the Cordon.
I have a transmuter for artifacts, I'm interested in recipes for it.
Okay, I can sell you recipes for transmutation. Each one will you cost you 1000 roubles. I'll upload the ones you've bought to your PDA.
For this specific transmutation you need: Bagel and Zuda artifacts.
The conversion requires: Strong gravitational artifact and Strong Needles.
For this specific transmutation you need: Strong Needles and Double Dummy artifacts.
For this specific transmutation you need: Radioactive Bolt and Rusty Hair artifacts.
For this specific transmutation you need: Knot and Burning Cotton artifacts.
For this specific transmutation you need: Weak Gravitational and Gravitational artifacts.
For this specific transmutation you need: Toad's Eye and Transparent Ball artifacts.

Electrical supply data.
Data about the presence of a powerful source of electric generator directly behind the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant.
The data has been corrupted.
Backup code for the entrance to the lower level of the energy center located in the underground segment of the facility at Radar- Data corrupted

Features: Protects from fire, acid, gases, from various abnormal influences and burning fluff. Increases protection from physical damage. Carries two oxygen cylinders. Specifics: with prolonged use it becomes unusable - damaged and torn.

Not much, believe me. It's a rare device. Not every soldier in the Zone is willing to share it. Alright, it's self-contained, and its battery charge is gonna last long enough. If you need another one, just don't forget the money.

Anomalies are small areas of the Zone in which the laws of physics that are familiar to everyone no longer apply. Anomalies produce artifacts - various kinds of items with unique properties that stalkers hunt for. Anomalies, along with mutants, are a key feature that distinguishes the Zone from the rest of the surface of planet Earth. Features:
- spawn artifacts when monsters die in them
- can be deactivated when spawning an artifact
- can be deactivated by specialized equipment
- deactivated anomalies are reactivated after an emission occurs

Features:
- to get all of the information about the properties of an artifact, you need a information about the relevant artifact downloaded to your PDA
- certain artifacts may have different prices and weight, depending on the sample
- the properties of an artifact may change after a blowout
- artifacts lose their properties when used
- a fully discharged artifact loses its properties

Features:
- some mutants are afraid of fire and psionic energy
- some non-mutated animals, such as rats and crows are edible (they can also be specially cooked on a campfire)
- some mutants have certain tissue samples that may be of interest to traders and scientists (you'll need relevant information about what kind of sample to collect downloaded to your PDA)
Unknown Stalker: This area is closed to loners, but if you're here on business, come to our base.
The leader of the Freedom faction asks for a Disintegrator and Zuda artifact or a payment of 10,000 for blowing up the door where the Psi Weapon scientist lived.

I had a strange dream. The hulk of the Chernobyl plant, shrouded in darkness. Everything looks peaceful. A lone man appears. I can see him from the back against the power plant. The wind is starting to blow. Suddenly, a sea of rats starts scattering away from the power plant in different directions. A man standing with his back to me, shooting rats. Suddenly, the man in the dream shouts out "Gunslinger!". Then the man flinches, freezes for a moment and slowly starts to turn towards me, but I wake up the moment before I get to see his face What does this dream mean? I don't know, but I think it's something I've seen before.
SOS: Somebody help! I'm in the house at the swamp!
Message - Sin Leader: Hmm, there he is.. He didn't get far. Finish him, stalker. He's already dead!
The NPC doesn't have enough money.
Your PDA's battery charge is almost drained

A protective suit, made by local craftsmen in the Zone. It has a special coating that protects against acidic anomalies, and gives decent protection against ballistic damage and trauma. It doesn't give more complete protection against anomalies and radiation if compared to more professionally-made protective suits since it lacks an airtight helmet.
This stalker suit is completely ruined. It'll keep you warm, but it'll provide almost zero protection against anything else.
[A huge amount of information is not readily available. It appears to be a mishmash of code that's impossible to understand until someone deciphers it.]

Got the gun from Toad. It's in rough shape, but at least it's something. I have to go down the road, and then go to the underpass. There's a stalker waiting for me there, I think I'll need to take someone down with him, or something.
Toad said a stalker from the death truck came by looking for me. I should find him in the swamp, he's obviously in one of the huts. Maybe he remembers something and can shed some light on things.

Winds of Madness... what does it all mean? Anyway, apparently the road to the center of the Zone goes through Lake Yantar, and there's a certain scientist at Yantar - someone going by the nickname of Professor. He's the one who's going to have to help me with this, but I don't know if he'll want to help me. To get what I need, I'll have to work for Professor first.

Docent handed out a prototype of a device that protects your brain if you're exposed to a blowout without shelter. But, in order for him to finish his work, this prototype must be laid out in the open while a blowout is occuring. Doing this without any sort of protection is dangerous business.
Press ($$ACTION_USE$$) to enter the code for the door
There's a blockage here. You can try to remove it.
Unknown stalker: Hey, you're a stalker! I'm at the tunnel! I'm inside here, please help me!
Damn, this anomaly.. Help me get out of here, please.

Messer, you're in the swamp area, aren't you? Got a little errand for you. The scientists at the science camp at Yantar ordered me to get water samples from there. If you're around, do them a favor. There's probably some vials in the abandoned labs somewhere, so you can use those to collect the water samples. Be careful when you go to Yantar, there's so much psionic radiation, you'll burn your brains out if you're careless. Anyway, get some samples, and then when you're near my bunker, drop them off. That's it.
Bartender: Stalker! You're near the passage to the Quiet Hills. Don't go there now, unless you want your brains to fry. Keep this in mind.
Bartender: Stalker! You are now near the passage to Yantar. Don't even think about going there now if you don't want your brains to get fried.
SOS: Come in! Somebody help me, I'm out here in the woods behind the swamp!
Watch out! You're right next to the anomalies. Use your bolts to determine where they're located.
%c[255,160,181,169]Toad:\n%c[255,245,240,218]Stalker! You're near the passage to Yantar now. Don't go there now if you don't want your brains to fry.
Don't go there now. This place is dead, the level of psionic activity is off the charts. Consider yourself warned, stalker.
Stalker, if you come near us, we will open fire. Leave.

%c[255,160,181,169]Toad:\n%c[255,245,240,218]I don't recommend going there, it's a scary place. It's so loud, it's really loud. Although sometimes bandits come from there - local bandits that tend to hang out near the bridge.

Not all items found in the Zone of Alienation are safe. Weapons, food, artifacts, objects, everything can be exposed to radioactive contamination.
Any individual object, even in a backpack, can absorb radiation if you enter an area that has heightened levels of background radiation. Be sure to carry a dosimeter or detector.
With a dosimeter, you can check if an object is contaminated. Just look it over in the backpack. If it's contaminated, the dosimeter will beep.
Now, a little bit about radiation sickness.
It is possible to get radiation sickness by staying in areas with high levels of radioactive contamination, or by eating contaminated food. It'll manifest as a permanent decline in health and stamina. On top of that, your vision will get a yellowish haze. The worse the contamination, the higher the negative effects.
It can only be fought by taking large quantities of anti-rads, vodka, and some scientists seem to be able to cure this ailment.
You can keep an eye on the contamination rate by getting checked out by scientists. They may have already made some sort of diagnostic device.
Toad, 05/21/2007.
One of the mobile science teams has gone missing in the Silent Hills area. I should try to find them, and if possible - find out what happened to them.

Stalker! Ah, phew.. I thought I was going to stay here forever. Our squad had a mission here.. everyone died. I ran away alone, hid, piled boxes here, fought back for the first time... damn, how long have I been here? I've been here for a day or two. Get me out of here, damn it, please.. I can't do it alone.
Alright, alright, just tell me how. As soon as I entered here, the door automatically closed. What was the mission of your squad and why did everyone die?

Closed? Holy shit. We were brought up on a standard nighttime alert. A few minutes to pack, then into the chopper. We got here last night. We had a couple of people with us in, you know - a bunch of eggheads in orange jumpsuits... they were with the equipment, but they're probably rotting around here somewhere. I don't know what it was. It came out of nowhere. We thought it was one of the surviving scientists, but this thing attacked the lieutenant... chewed off half his face. Damn it, get me out of here!

I don't know.. they wanted to turn off the radiation on the lower levels in order to gain access to some documents. I don't know the details of all this. Listen, in the main hall there, there should be an emergency switch for opening the front door. This is our chance.. what the?

When the commotion started, I accidentally got into some room, they didn't lock a damn thing in there, they must have been sure no one would get in. There's some sort of archive, I took as many folders as I could fit into my duffel bag. I don't know why, but they're prized in the Zone. The Watchdog wouldn't let us trade information. Maybe he was dealing it himself. I can't understand the content of these papers, but you can sell them for good money, which means I'll be able to eat.

We're thinking of doing a raid at Silent Hills. These dark ones are obviously up to something, so we need to do a little recon. The village to the west of the Hills will give us good cover. There's one problem though - there's a controller there. It must be destroyed.

Yeah, well, what did you expect? We've got plenty of explosives - that's for sure - but I'm not about to go tossing them around carelessly. So, here's the deal. You rustle up a couple of artifacts for me - a "Disintegrator" and a "Itch" - and I'll assign you one of our sappers; he'll take care of everything... But if you're short on artifacts, then fine - I'll take cash instead. Ten grand, and it's a done deal.

A stun gun, presumably developed in the northern part of the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone.\nAIt affects people and mutants by causing a feeling of intense panic, causing any would-be attacker to flee or stumble.

An anomalous weapon that harnesses the energy of gravitational artifacts, pieced together from various pieces of scrap metal. This weapon uses bolts for ammo, and the high velocity this weapon propels them at makes them incredibly lethal.
 
 Ammunition:
 5x25mm bolts

The science bunker at Yantar is experiencing food supply problems. It's necessary to bring them food so I can continue to cooperate with them further. I think ten cans of food will be enough for them. It's worth talking to Toad, maybe he can sell large bulk orders of food.
Messer! My equipment indicates are that you are very close to the installation. Be careful!
Expect no audience with me, stalker. All questions must be directed to our assistant in the annex next to the bunker.

Professor needs a measurement of air infected with spores from a certain parasite. In order to do this, I'll have to deploy this device given to me by Professor near any corpse infected with the parasite and then return it to him once it collects the data it needs.

Hello! We've got a little problem with an expedition that went missing in the Silent Hills. Their signal was lost in the area around the base there. Could you check that place out and see if anything happened to them?
